newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DMCI forges jv for water utility project.
newsitem.headline: DMCI forges jv for water utility project.

text.p: DM Consunji Inc said on Wednesday it won a contract to improve, operate and manage the water and sewerage facilities in the northern Philippine city of Olongapo which includes Subic Bay Freeport.

The Philippine construction giant said in a statement the project would be undertaken by a joint venture formed along with British firm Biwater International Ltd, Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority and the Olongapo City Water District for the project.
The joint venture firm, Subic Water and Sewerage Co Inc, was given a 25-year "renewable" franchise on the project.
"It is the first build-operate-transfer contract for a water and sewerage utility company in southeast Asia with a 10-year construction programme, estimated to cost 2.3 billion pesos," DMCI said.
